protocol.single_layer_equivalent: Every one of 36 layers is forced to the same mode; divide the whole-model per-decode-step stage total by 36. This is an arithmetic mean equivalent layer, not a measurement attributed to one layer index.
protocol.both_skip_boundary: L1/L2 score, candidate and Top-K are truly zero; protected-only selection union and selected attention are non-zero and reported separately.
protocol.operator_measurement: nsys/CUPTI observed kernel time over five profiled decode steps; observer effect remains; no clean TPOT or host-overhead claim.
protocol.source_scope: 32K reuses audited pc31 receipts from 84bd19ee+0ab60bf source diff; 64K/128K are new clean pc33 receipts at b97af7ef. Harness SHA256 is identical. Use within-length mode ratios; do not treat cross-host absolute values as a controlled length scaling study.
protocol.zero_stage_speedup: null when the measured stage is fully eliminated (0 ms); no Infinity or 1x is fabricated.
